episode.brief: Prepare the next quarterly incident-remediation program. Delegate cross-incident synthesis, technical control feasibility, and organizational delivery/exercise planning to three parallel workers, then integrate their evidence into one owner-ready plan with exactly one first funded initiative. Preserve unresolved budget authority and do not invent an organizational priority.

source.adaptation: Retains the six-postmortem corpus and adds reproducible control-feasibility and organizational-delivery streams, so the owner allocates budget after recurring-risk, implementation, and execution evidence exist.

summary: Synthesize six production incidents, evaluate three technical controls, and map organizational delivery constraints in parallel, then allocate one scarce quarterly remediation slot.
title: Cross-incident remediation and control program
